data.name: Arham
data.gender_notes: Arham is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elative of the root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'mercy' — 'most merciful'. Its root is ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m). A Qur'anic elative form. Arham is a Arabic name meaning “Most merciful; most compassionate”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arham expresses “Most merciful; most compassionate”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Elative of the root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'mercy' — 'most merciful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arham total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
